goal: Failures of an individual page, renderer, transport or publisher should degrade safely rather than corrupt shared source. No claim of zero-impact failures without independent redundancy.
invariants: Canonical source has versioned Git history
Public projections carry source pointer and correction route
No required sign-in to read source or try public research
No source contains private voter records or credentials
Site outage cannot trigger automatic political messages
Published correction supersedes misleading claim; old versions remain attributable
No single numeric integrity score manufactures allegations

failure_domains.if_lost: Most current public source and Pages paths may fail together
Custom-domain entrypoints may fail; do not claim operational redirects
Existing public source may still be available; no automatic backup social account
No readproof or failover role is established

failure_domains.role: Authoritative original-source paths rather than fallback CoCivium hosting

degrade_rules.next: Use original GitHub source where independently reachable; report DEGRADED_SAME_PROVIDER
degrade_rules.stop: Do not automatically claim mirror or send mass redirection

degrade_rules.next: Hide affected projection or label HELD; other independently usable experiments remain
degrade_rules.stop: Do not bury limitation in footer

degrade_rules.next: Report NO_VERIFIED_OFFSITE_SOURCE; refer to official public authorities for election procedures
Hold posts; preserve approved source and draft
degrade_rules.stop: No impersonated account or automatic substitute

degrade_rules.next: Stop propagation; preserve safely attributed correction and refer to competent official process
degrade_rules.stop: No blanket broadcast, reputation scoring, personal doxxing

degrade_rules.event: New evidence disagrees with existing content
degrade_rules.next: Label DISPUTED, preserve source lineage and invite independent counterexample

proof_trail: External HTTPS retrieval in independent runtime

desired_probes.scope: Public-read-only, bounded, no secrets and no private node checks

success_metric: Independent readers still obtain a correct source or explicit status when any one proven independent dependency fails.
